node.statement: At profile (4,4,S=20), the exact relevant local valuations are {1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12,16,17,18,20}, the cofactor is at most 1707433 and has form 2^mu(1+256t), and the residue-degree sieve leaves 1133 necessary-sieve values. Fourteen pure branches already survive against a seven-orbit allowance, so the local ideal-router extension is not a closing method.
